Proto-Indo-European *h₂ey-
Proto-Indo-European *-u

Proto-Indo-European *-osinflu.
Proto-Germanic *aiwaz

Old High German io
Old High German mēr
Old High German iomēr
Middle High German iemer
German immer
From Middle High German iemer (also imer, immer), from Old High German iomēr (“always”).
Cognate with Dutch immer, Alemannic German immer, German Low German immer, ümmer, jümmer, jümmers, Middle English a mare, aa mare (“evermore”).
